expected_root_cause: The pod's container requests far more CPU (100 cores) than any node in the cluster has available, so the scheduler cannot find a node with sufficient allocatable capacity and the pod stays Pending.
key_evidence: A FailedScheduling event on the pod mentioning insufficient cpu
top_nodes or node capacity/allocatable figures showing far less CPU available than the pod requests
should_not_conclude: A node taint or nodeSelector mismatch is the cause
